data.name: Rasu
data.gender_notes: Rasu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rasu is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘rasa’, which means juice, essence or flavor. In Hindu mythology, Rasu is also considered a form of the goddess Lakshmi, who represents wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. It is also believed that the name Rasu can bring joy, happiness, and harmony to one's life. The name Rasu carries the meaning “Juice, Essence” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Rasu usually hope their child will grow to embody juice, essence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the essence of life and the divine nectar of knowledge and wisdom. It is a reminder to seek the purest form of happiness and inner peace.
data.etymology: Rasu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Juice, Essence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rasu total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
